pages.text: This appendix covers alternate stations, reversible crafts, and optional-integration recipes not expanded page by page in the main flow. Every other recipe is displayed directly in the materials, pills, equipment, storage, or automation chapters.

pages.title: Spirit-Iron Blasting
pages.text: Both normal and deepslate Spirit Iron Ore can be rapidly refined in a blast furnace.

pages.title: Alternative Remains Firing
pages.text: A furnace or blast furnace produces alloy scrap; see Immortal Forging for Immortal-Furnace firing.

pages.title: Alternative Tempering
pages.text: Furnace and blast-furnace routes also temper Spirit Swords; the Immortal Furnace is faster.

pages.title: World-Barrier Reversal
pages.text: Primordial Qi shapelessly condenses into World Barrier and converts back without loss.

pages.title: Stabilized Reset
pages.text: Craft a Stabilized Miniature Immortal Ruin alone to clear its saved state and receive a reset copy.

pages.title: Integration Crystal Cycle I
pages.text: Cycle the electric crystal into Mana or Source according to the integrations currently installed.

pages.title: Integration Crystal Cycle II
pages.text: With both Botania and Ars Nouveau installed, the Mana crystal cycles into the Source crystal.

pages.title: Six Stonecutter Conversions
pages.text: Stonecutter recipes: immortalstorage:crystal_electric_from_mana_stonecutting, immortalstorage:crystal_electric_from_source_stonecutting, immortalstorage:crystal_mana_from_electric_stonecutting, immortalstorage:crystal_mana_from_source_stonecutting, immortalstorage:crystal_source_from_electric_stonecutting, and immortalstorage:crystal_source_from_mana_stonecutting. Each is hidden unless its required mod exists.
